<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break an aliphatic hydroxyl group and form an alkyl halide (C–O bond broken, C–X bond formed). This matches the described substitution of a leaving hydroxyl with a halogen. I will query the database with these functional group criteria and retrieve the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC=O)c1.Fc1cnc(N(C)C)nc1Cl", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
